what: Dedup test targets claude argv, not launcher→subprocess forwarding
scenario_or_breakage: launch-claude-review.sh invokes launch-claude-subprocess.sh by absolute path; subprocess embeds context into PROMPT_RENDERED and calls claude with only --model/--print on stdin, so grepping a stub claude "$@" log cannot observe --context-files dedup
suggested_fix: Count <context_file_N> markers in stub stdin (or add a test-only subprocess argv capture hook) and assert exactly one block when --diff-file and --context-files reference the same path
